heuristics: Class walk with 2048 random jumps behaves like a random mapping on M=(r-1)/(6*2^20) classes within a 10 percent step margin (Teske 2001; van Oorschot-Wiener 1999)
Low bits of the canonical x-coordinate are uniform, so distinguished points occur at rate 2^-90
Tame and wild trails are independent except for merges (Poisson merge model)
limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification
Instruction ledger is an analytic upper bound, not a built implementation; loads count one instruction and latency is not charged
Requires about 5.1 PB of fixed-base tables (storage-cluster scale, unscored by the model) and the supplied power A_(2^20); the bound is stated for n>=2^20 only
